content.text: In Kenya, digital creators face a significant challenge: restricted access to payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal. This limitation hinders their ability to sell digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software, to a global audience. The need for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-27|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-3|infrastructure]] has never been more pressing. With the right tools and knowledge, you can deploy your own digital commerce stack, leveraging [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-step-step-deployment-6|Crypto Payments]] payments and breaking free from platform dependencies.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The traditional payment processing landscape is fraught with restrictions, high fees, and limited access. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure built on blockchain technology and crypto payments offers a censorship-resistant, low-cost, and globally accessible alternative. By leveraging platforms like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, you can create a resilient and adaptable digital commerce stack that puts you in control of your sales and customer data.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, you need to have a clear understanding of your product offerings, target audience, and marketing strategy. You should also familiarize yourself with the technical requirements of your chosen infrastructure, including the setup of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. Additionally, you need to have a basic understanding of cryptocurrency and its applications in e-commerce.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your digital commerce stack. This includes configuring your payment gateway, setting up automatic delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and testing your pipeline to ensure seamless transactions. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, and with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of your digital products.
Build your sovereign commerce infrastructure today.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Break free from platform dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for $197, provides you with the necessary tools and knowledge to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. With this kit, you can build a resilient and adaptable infrastructure that meets your unique needs and helps you scale your business.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital commerce stack, follow these steps: set up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configure your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrate NOWPayments, test your payment and delivery pipeline, configure your storefront, load your products, and go live. By following these steps, you can create a fully functional digital commerce stack that puts you in control of your sales and customer data.
